tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: List researched real estate platforms and their current status. Free.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Inspect current source operations, supported selectors, and markets before requesting data. Free.

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: List the unified API operations. Contract inclusion does not guarantee live source availability.

tools.name: get_endpoint
tools.description: Read an operation’s parameters, request schema and referenced component schemas.

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Execute one source read or search. May consume credits. No automatic retry or pagination. POST search requests need a stable idempotency key.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: call_endpoint · Public sink: call_endpoint · Destructive: call_endpoint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: call_endpoint · Public sink: call_endpoint · Destructive: call_endpoint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
